study_note: Two-seed Humanoid Walk parity check using seeds 0 and 1 and the released XQC one-million-raw-frame protocol: action repeat two, 500k agent decisions, UTD two, 5k-decision warmup, and ten deterministic evaluation episodes after decision one and every 50k decisions. This checks the port against the released implementation and its ten-seed paper curve; it is not a statistical reproduction of the paper result.
